instagram_caption:
Wibbo has to sneeze! He put the tissue on his antenna, then waved it up high. No, Wibbo!

Sneeze into a tissue and throw it away. No tissue? Use your elbow, not your hands. Then wash your hands.

Silly Wibbo. Smart kids.

Can YOU do a pretend elbow sneeze?

#wibbo #kidslearning #healthyhabits #sneeze #funnykids
youtube_title: Wibbo Has to Sneeze! Tissue on His Antenna? No, Wibbo!
youtube_description:
Wibbo needs to sneeze and gets it all wrong. Learn the right way: sneeze into a tissue and throw it away, or use your elbow if you don't have a tissue, not your hands. Then wash your hands.

Sources:
